findings.title: Nested Structure arrays report successful generation of invalid ES300 GLSL

steps: Create Structure with a field of outer length3 array whose element is a length2 float array, plus scalar field b.
Create its constructor and field b accessor; connect b into the working Compose flow.
Compile the admitted graph using the shipped es300 profile.
Compile returned shaders independently in Chromium151 WebGL2.
counterexample.actual: Graph diagnostics=[], compile status=success, but fragment source contains float[2][3] for 3 arrays of 2 and an array constructor with three float[2] arguments. WebGL2 rejects arrays-of-arrays for ES300 and constructor arity. Candidate vertex and independent control fragment both compile.
